atomic_switch_rehearsal.mechanism: symlink 'current' -> versions/<v>; atomic replace via temp symlink + rename; ledger entry committed by temp-file write + fsync + rename; rollback = same atomic swap back

observed.v2_refreshed_token: token-v2-refreshed (newer synthetic marker written after deploy)

limits: Rehearsal only: synthetic version dirs and synthetic token marker; never reads or writes any real agent.db.
Symlink swap and ledger entry are each individually atomic (rename) but are two separate commits: a crash between them leaves 'current' switched with no ledger entry; no transaction spans both.
